gloss: the ~ crowd; the ~ contingent; group of people

definitions.gloss: the ~ crowd; the ~ group; the ~ contingent
definitions.explanation: Attaches to a noun to name the set of people who share an attribute, position, or attitude — for example {若手|わかて}{勢|ぜい} (the younger contingent) or ガチ{勢|ぜい} (the serious players).

examples.japanese: ⟦{上位|じょうい}→上位：11188_joui⟧{勢|ぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若手|わかて}{勢|ぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}った→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
examples.english: The strong showing of the younger contingent stood out at this tournament.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧⟦ガチ{勢|ぜい}→ガチ勢：06470_gachizei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦エンジョイ{勢|ぜい}→エンジョイ勢：29810_enjoizei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This game has a serious crowd chasing records and a casual crowd who just play for fun.

notes:
From {勢|せい} (force, troops), voiced to ぜい as a suffix. Originally used of military forces and sports contingents; it is now freely productive online, where new ~{勢|ぜい} words are coined constantly.

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{上位|じょうい}→上位：11188_joui⟧{勢|ぜい}: the top-ranked competitors
- {若手|わかて}{勢|ぜい}: the younger group
- ⟦ガチ{勢|ぜい}→ガチ勢：06470_gachizei⟧: the hardcore, serious players
- ⟦エンジョイ{勢|ぜい}→エンジョイ勢：29810_enjoizei⟧: the casual players
- ⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧{勢|ぜい}: the working-adult contingent

REGISTER: the established combinations (⟦{上位|じょうい}→上位：11188_joui⟧{勢|ぜい}, {若手|わかて}{勢|ぜい}) appear in sports reporting; freshly coined ones are casual internet usage.
